MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.rules: The check activities cost 1 DTP per attempt, whether they succeed or fail. Their starred (*) options normally cost 10 gp × PC level. Character gold is used first; if it cannot cover the full fee, an assigned, accessible group's Party Treasure pays the full fee instead. A GM must be online for Party Treasure payments. Pass the listed check to succeed. Luck tokens cannot be used on these checks. Carousing uses its own event rules.

MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.sharedPaymentFailed: The downtime payment could not be made. Check access and the available DTP or gold.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.teachingRules: Choose another character who knows the skill or language. Each attempt costs the learner and teacher 1 DTP each, on success or failure, and no gold. A GM must be online; the GM confirms what can be taught.

MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.carousingRules: Carousing* has its own event cost, duration and outcome-based DTP cost. Open Carousing to view its rules and outcome table.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.rules: Requires a Tavern in a suitable sanctuary. Participants contribute toward one total event cost. Each rolls 1d8 + the event bonus (a number or an extra 1d6) + an applicable Brewery bonus. Group mode uses one selected participant's roll for everyone. Each character gains the listed XP and pays the listed DTP cost.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.gmResolution: The GM resolves the event and applies XP, DTP, contributions and luck tokens. Character owners can view these rules and outcomes.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.availability: The GM confirms that the sanctuary and Tavern can host this event. A Bastion must have its Tavern built and can host events costing at most 100 gp in total; its Brewery adds +1. Higher-cost events need another suitable sanctuary. Contributions must add up to the total event cost.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.balanceRule: Each participant must hold enough DTP to cover the highest possible result for this bonus (5–8 DTP). Only the rolled outcome's DTP cost is deducted.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.consequences: The GM resolves fines, donations, imprisonment, the CON check and disease, allies, tavern bans, debts, and item rewards. Item (80–100) and Item (90–100) are reward-table ranges, not gold values.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.pending: Outcomes recorded; resource and campaign time updates pending.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.complete: XP, DTP, contributions and luck applied; confirmed campaign time advanced.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.invalid: Enter a suitable Tavern location, a positive whole-gp cost, a bonus number or 1d6, and a positive duration in days.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.tavernLimit: A Bastion Tavern can host events costing at most 100 gp in total. Choose another suitable sanctuary for this event.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.resources: {actor} needs the contribution in gp and at least {dtp} DTP to cover every possible result.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.contributions: Each participant must contribute, and contributions must add up exactly to the total event cost.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.rollerRequired: The group roller must be a selected participant.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.unavailable: Carousing dice, actor updates, chat or campaign time are unavailable.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.review: Carousing did not finish. Review the saved chat outcomes, character resources and campaign time before making corrections. Do not reroll this event.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.failed: Carousing could not be completed. No resource or time updates were started.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.confirm: Host this event at {location} for {cost} gp over {days} days. Roll 1d8 + {bonus} + {brewery} Brewery bonus. Each participant must have {dtp} DTP; the rolled outcome sets the exact DTP cost.
MK_SHADOWDARK.carousing.confirmTime: Confirm that the location is available and this duration is the campaign time to spend. Resolving advances Foundry's world time once for the whole event.

Assign travel tasks and track the journey.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.camping.de: Assign camp tasks and manage the party's rest.
Manage shared gear and party treasure.
Track hirelings, owners, and carrying capacity.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.mounts.des: Assign riders and track carrying capacity.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.party.body:
Build the roster. The GM can drop player characters onto the Party sidebar. The count shows active party members / total roster. Right-click a character to move them between the active party and the roster, open their sheet, or remove their group link.

Use a character. Click their portrait to open the character sheet. Click the rest of the header to expand or collapse their stats, then click an ability to make a check. Drag active party members onto travel tasks, camping tasks, or mounts to assign them.

Active party. Active members take part in travel, camping, and Rest Party. Roster members remain linked and available as hireling owners. Only the GM can change the active party or remove group members.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.summary.bo:
Overview. Summary shows Party Treasure, weekly payroll, hirelings and their owners, warbands and their deployments, mounts and riders, boats and their assignments, and linked bastions.

Weekly payroll. Each hireling costs 1 gp per week. Each warband unit costs 3 gp × its level per week. Boat and bastion assignment quantities count as separate units; an unassigned warband counts as one unit following the group. A built Granary reduces wages by 3 gp per unit stationed at that bastion, to a minimum of 0 gp.

Subtotals. Missing actors, levels, or bastion assignment data leave payroll marked as a subtotal. These figures are a payroll reference; the GM handles payment.
Assign tasks. Drag active party members onto Pathfind, March, Lookout, or Scavenge, or use a task's assignment picker. Each member has one travel task. Members without an explicit task default to Lookout.

Submit checks. The GM uses Prompt Travelling to request rolls. Players roll for characters they control; the GM can roll for any assigned character. Checks use Shadowdark's normal dialog with editable modifiers and advantage/disadvantage. Every required check must be submitted before progress begins.

Resolve the journey. Stored results appear at each activity breakpoint. A task succeeds if at least one assigned check succeeds; a task with no assigned characters fails. The GM applies the journey's consequences.

Journey controls. Speed, MPH, and Hexes record travel settings. The GM can roll weather using the configured temperature and wind tables. Reset Travel Assignments clears assignments and the current prompt/results; unassigned active members return to Lookout.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.camping.bo:
Assign camp tasks. Drag active members onto tasks or use the assignment picker. Each character can have one camping task. Click an assigned character's portrait to open their sheet and roll the listed ability check against the displayed DC, choosing one of the listed abilities when the task offers a choice. The GM applies the task benefits below.

Campfire. The PCs can make a campfire using 3 torches. It lasts 8 hours while a PC remains near it and casts light to a near distance. A successful Scavenge task provides one campfire this rest without spending torches.

Supplies and rest. The supply counters include matching food and torch items carried by members plus shared inventory. Lost items are excluded. Rest Party lets the GM choose how many tracked rations to consume from active party members, distributes that deduction as evenly as their supplies allow, then rests those characters using the configured rest mode. Move shared food to a party member before consuming it through Rest Party.

Reset. Reset Camping Assignments clears camp task assignments for the next rest.
Shared gear. Item cards show each stack's icon, name, type, slot cost, and quantity. Click an icon or name to open its item sheet. To add gear, drag an Item into the Shared Items grid or press + to create an item. Use the card's −/+ controls to change quantity.

Carrying capacity. The limit is the combined hireling carrying slots and mounts' free gear slots. Item slot use follows the stack's configured quantity, items per slot, slot size, and free carry allowance. Stashed and nonphysical items use no shared gear slots. Exceeding the limit highlights the total for the GM to resolve.

Move and divide. Players with Observer or Owner access to the group can drag a full shared item stack onto a character sheet they own; an active GM processes the move. Party Treasure tracks GP, SP, and CP separately, with its own coin-slot figure and Divide Coins control.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.shared-ite:
Add shared gear. The GM can drag Items from a character sheet, the Items directory, or a compendium into the Shared Items grid, or press + to create an item.

Item cards. Click an icon or name to inspect the item. Quantity controls change the stack; reducing a stack to zero asks whether to delete it.

Slots. Each card shows the whole stack's gear-slot cost, accounting for quantity, items per slot, slot size, and free carry. Stashed and nonphysical items cost zero slots. The shared limit comes from hirelings and mounts' free carrying capacity.

Transfer a stack. A player with Observer or Owner group access can drag a card onto a character sheet they own, including Character Dashboard equipment and Quick Slots. The full stack moves, retaining its item data and quantity. An active GM must be connected to process player transfers.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.treasure.b:
Balances. Track the group's GP, SP, and CP in the treasure fields. The coin-slot figure reflects the group's coin carry allowance.

Divide Coins. After confirmation, each player character in the complete group roster receives an equal whole-number share of each denomination. This includes characters outside the active party. GP, SP, and CP are divided separately; remainders stay in Party Treasure.
Manage hirelings. The GM can add and remove hirelings and edit each name, background/profession, owner, and carrying slots. Owners can be any player character in the full group roster, including inactive members, or Unassigned.

Capacity and wages. Each hireling's nonnegative carrying slots add directly to the shared inventory limit. Each hireling entry costs 1 gp per week in Summary payroll.

Ownership. Removing a character from the group clears their hireling ownership. Moving that character out of the active party keeps the ownership assignment.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.warbands.b:
Link warbands. The GM can drop an NPC actor representing a warband anywhere in the Warbands tab or onto its tab icon. Cards show the linked actor's current level, AC, and HP. Click a card to open its sheet; the trash button removes only the group link.

Deployments. Unassigned warbands follow the group. Assign a warband in a boat's Warbands area in the Boats tab, or in a linked bastion's Defenses tab. Badges show every destination and quantity.

Weekly wages. Each assigned unit costs 3 gp × warband level. An unassigned warband counts as one unit. A built Granary reduces the cost by 3 gp per unit stationed at that bastion, with a minimum of 0 gp per unit. Other destinations use the full cost. Missing actors, levels, or deployment data leave Summary payroll marked as a subtotal.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.mounts.bod:
Add a mount. The GM can drop an NPC mount anywhere in the Mounts section.

Assign a rider. Drag an active party member from the Party sidebar onto the mount's card. Remove Rider frees the mount's rider allowance; the trash button removes the mount from the group. Cards show the rider, free gear slots, and tracked HP.

Mount rules

  • A mount acts on the rider's initiative; the rider chooses the mount's action.
  • Mounting or dismounting uses the rider's entire movement.
  • Gear slots equal 5 × the mount's STR bonus. A rider and their carried gear use 10 slots. Free carrying capacity is never less than 0 and contributes to the shared inventory limit.
  • A mount needs 1 ration each day in an unfamiliar environment.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.boats.body:
Link boats. The GM can drop an NPC boat anywhere in the Boats tab or onto its tab icon. Click a boat to open its actor sheet. Edit its Captain name on the boat card.

Assign crew and warbands. Drop NPC actors into the boat's Crew or Warbands area. Set each assignment's quantity to a whole number of at least 1.

Crew slots. Each crew member uses 1 slot; each warband uses 20 slots. Multiply by the assigned quantity. Total crew capacity equals the boat's maximum HP; damage to current HP leaves that capacity unchanged.

Capacity changes. New assignments and quantity changes must fit the boat's capacity. If maximum HP falls below the existing load, the card shows the excess and keeps the assignments for the GM to adjust.

Unassigning. Remove an assignment to free its slots, or remove the boat's group link. The linked NPC actors remain available.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.bastions.b:
Link bastions. The GM can drop a Bastion actor anywhere in the Bastion tab or onto its tab icon. Click a linked bastion to open its Bastion Sheet. The trash button removes the group link while keeping the Bastion actor.

Manage the bastion. Use its standalone sheet for structure rules, upgrades, Defenses, and the Vault. Assign stationed warbands in Defenses; the Group Sheet reads their destinations and quantities for warband cards and Summary.

Granary wages. A built Granary reduces wages by 3 gp per stationed warband unit per week, including quantities, with a minimum of 0 gp per unit. Link the bastion to the group so its deployments and discounts are included in the group's payroll.
MK_SHADOWDARK.groupSheet.help.active-tor:
Light tracker. This bar lists active light-source items whose names match the configured torch keywords, from party members and shared inventory. Each entry names the torch and its holder.

Remaining light. The four segments show the fraction of the item's configured light duration remaining, rounded up to the next quarter. Use the holder's item sheet and Shadowdark's light controls to light or extinguish a torch and manage its duration.
